name: Oatith
source:
Species: Derata (non-humanoid)
Origin: Indaegawan (Planet Indaegawa)

An alien that doesn't leave his hard-shell pod that can open or close at will. He can consume most organic food, but he also uses sexual energy emitted by other species as sustenance.

Likes: Communicating, getting his way, resting, playing, bringing people pleasure
Dislikes: Concentrated levels of CO₂, salt, being opened against his will, too much wind

"[Series of pulses]"
